Name: NPC Diary
Author: slpOff
Description:
[b]NPC Diary (Test Build)[/b][i]
A personal log for your daily interactions with Pelican Town residents.[/i][line][b]Overview

[/b]Ever wondered how your relationships evolve day by day?

[b]NPC Diary[/b] automatically records your interactions with villagers — conversations, gifts, and small daily details — turning your social life into a personal journal inside the game.It’s not just a calendar. It’s a living diary that grows with every talk, gift, and shared moment.[line][b]Current Features (Test Phase)[/b][list]
[*][b]Daily Dialogue Recording[/b]
Whenever you talk to an NPC, their dialogue is automatically saved in your diary for that day.
[*][b]Gift Reaction Tracking[/b]
When you give a present, the NPC’s reaction is logged — along with the item name and their response text.
[*][b]Personal Notes[/b]
Write your own thoughts for each day. You can edit or delete notes directly through the diary panel.
[*][b]Calendar Integration[/b]
Access your diary through the NPC’s profile page.
Each day is displayed in a seasonal calendar, showing:[list]
[*]Birthday icons (only for the current season)
[*]Small symbols for days with dialogue or gift records
[*]Dimmed colors for days you didn’t interact with that NPC
[/list]
[*][b]Seasonal Filtering[/b]
Only birthdays from the current season are displayed. No more all-season clutter.
[*][b]Automatic Updates[/b]
The diary updates whenever you talk or give a gift — no manual input required.
[/list][line][b]Planned Improvements[/b][list]
[*]Full event summary system (e.g., festivals, heart events)
[*]Improved note editor with multi-line text
[*]Search and sort options by friendship level
[*]Dynamic NPC schedule integration (linking recorded events with actual in-game routines)
[/list][line][b]Compatibility[/b][list]
[*]Works with both vanilla and modded NPCs.
[*]Designed for SMAPI 4.0+.
[*]Safe to install/uninstall mid-save (diary data is stored separately).
[/list][line][b]Known Issues (v0.1 Test Build)[/b][list]
[*]Some NPC schedules fail to parse correctly.
[*]Calendar UI may not update instantly when switching seasons.
[*]Diary deletion doesn’t always remove the associated event.
[*]Base game schedule data isn’t affected by diary edits yet.
[/list]
